title: Price of a Single Design Commitment across Response Classes in Blocked Experiments
banked_reason: Sound exact block-diagonal productization and local-LMI reduction, but the expected decoupling mechanism, engineered direct-sum scope, and unresolved coupled-kernel case make this a subfield methodological note rather than a field-level paper.
gap_reasons: Its substantive boundary is the direct-sum kernel restriction: cross-block kernels receive only an exponentially indexed mass-simplex formulation, not an efficient characterization or productization theorem.
The higher-rank theorem's 'sharp finite-n additive trace-relaxation gap' is simply the difference between two computed optima rather than an analytic gap bound.
Its polynomial support reduction is existential rather than algorithmic.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved that, for heterogeneous finite centrally symmetric balanced block supports and a finite menu of centered block-diagonal PSD kernels, preserving local marginals and independently productizing blocks Pareto-dominates cross-block coupling and yields an exact polynomial-size local-LMI SDP. The mathematical result passed both D0.5 panels, but a human venue-level adjudication downgraded it because the decoupling mechanism is expected once direct-sum geometry is imposed and genuinely coupled kernels still require the exponential mass-simplex program. No Lean formalization was produced because the run was stopped immediately after F1 dispatch.
tldr: For a finite population partitioned into heterogeneous even-sized blocks, each with an explicitly listed nonempty centrally symmetric balanced assignment support, the generalized headline proves that replacing any blinded law by the independent-block, independent-symmetric-sign law with the same local sign-pair masses preserves every diagonal covariance block, deletes cross-block covariance, and weakly lowers every worst-case variance in any finite menu of direct-sum centered PSD response kernels. This yields an exact finite-sample commitment SDP with \(1+\sum_\ell m_\ell\) variables and one LMI of order at most \(b_\ell-1\) per class--block pair, without enumerating the global Cartesian-product support. The matched-quadruple order-three SDP, rank-one LP, and homogeneous two-class closed form are exact corollaries. The causal estimand is the fixed finite-population treatment effect; the commitment values are design-selection criteria.
gap: Single-class causal randomization results determine one response-class oracle, and general multi-objective design results provide established saddle and binding-weight technology. They do not give a quantitative finite-population price for committing across response geometries, a matching observable spectral certificate, or a direct comparison with the exact published relative-efficiency formula.
fill: The project derives the exact finite-\(n\) frontier \(\lambda^\star=(a-2b)/(a+b)\), proves sharpness through matching trace and eigenvalue bounds, supplies the attaining block-balanced law, establishes strict improvement over block complete randomization for both classes, and proves stable nonrepresentability against Ryan--Esserman--Li equation (8) on the same two-scenario variance subproblem.
